document.title: From field observations to useful evidence
document.description: A conceptual monitoring workflow with illustrated objects and an explicit review cycle.

sections.title: 01 / Establish the observation context
sections.description: Illustrative workflow; no measured values or installation details are asserted.

items.title: Observation site
items.description: Record the location and the conditions that help explain a reading.

items.title: Monitoring instrument
items.description: Preserve the measurement time, units and instrument identity.

items.title: Observation record
items.description: Keep the reading with calibration and maintenance information.

items.title: Capture
items.description: Collect readings together with the context needed to interpret them.

items.title: Check
items.description: Review calibration, unusual values and gaps; retain flags and uncertainty.

items.title: Preserve
items.description: Store the original observations and the documented review decisions.

items.title: Improve the next capture
items.description: Use review findings to plan maintenance and future observations.
